issues.element: Toolbar row 2: 'Refresh' wraps onto its own row, left-aligned under 'Last hour', while 'Current bucket: hour' and 'Clear filters' stay at the right end of the time-range row. This orphans the button and adds about 40px of toolbar height above the chart (r11 at 1366 kept Refresh in-row). Same on tokens-1366.
issues.fix: Keep 'Clear filters' and 'Refresh' together as one non-wrapping right-aligned cluster. When the row is too narrow, hide 'Current bucket: hour' first (as at 1280) or move the whole cluster to the search row. Never let only Refresh wrap.

issues.element: The same orphaned 'Refresh' row pushes the Token trend down, so the footnotes and 'View data table' fall below the fold on a common laptop size
issues.fix: Same fix as the overview at 1366: one atomic right-aligned action cluster, with the bucket caption dropped before anything wraps

issues.element: 'Apply' (search row) is the only white filled button on the page. It shows full primary emphasis while the search box is empty, so the strongest affordance on screen does nothing. In error-1440 and error-2293 it turns grey without a visible reason.
issues.fix: Show Apply as a secondary/disabled button until the search text differs from the applied value, and give it the primary fill only when there is something to apply (or apply on Enter or debounce and drop the button). Use the same rule in every state.

issues.element: 'Clear filters' looks enabled at the default state (All providers / All models / All outcomes / empty search). It has the same weight as Refresh, so the user can't tell whether any filter is active.
issues.fix: Disable or hide 'Clear filters' when every filter is at its default. When filters are active, show a count, e.g. 'Clear filters (2)'.

issues.element: The top-right header utility group (refresh / globe / logout icons) sits in a 52px-tall, heavily rounded bordered box. It matches no other control's height, radius or border, and its refresh icon duplicates the toolbar 'Refresh' button directly beneath it.
issues.fix: Give the header group the same control height (about 30px desktop) and radius as the toolbar buttons. Either remove the header refresh on this page or label both so the user knows which one reloads analytics.

issues.element: The 3-column view grid wraps 'Tokens & Cache' and 'Model Rates' onto 2 lines. In expanded filters (expanded/tokens-320), 'Last 24 hours' and 'Last 30 days' also wrap to 2 lines inside the selected pill, so cell heights differ.
issues.fix: Below about 360px, switch the view and time-range segmented grids to 2 columns, or keep labels on one line with nowrap and a smaller horizontal padding

issues.element: Disclosure links 'View data table', 'Coverage limitations', 'Measurement details' and 'Rate details' use 11–12px text with roughly 16–20px tall hit areas, below the 24px minimum target (WCAG 2.5.8), especially at 390/320 where they are the only way into the data tables.
issues.fix: Give the summary elements min-height 24px on desktop and 44px on coarse pointers (padding, not bigger text), and keep the caret inside the hit area

issues.element: Chart footnote 'Hover or focus a time to compare values; activate it to open matching events.' is shown on touch layouts, where there is no hover
issues.fix: Under pointer:coarse, say 'Tap a time to compare values; tap again to open matching events'

issues.element: KPI row: the Failed events note 'No change across the range' sits inline beside the value and wraps to two lines. The 'p95 execution duration · ms' label wraps, so values (128 / 8 / $1,547.35 / 2,400) sit on different baselines and the Estimated cost sparkline drops below its value. The toolbar puts 'Clear filters' and 'Refresh' alone on a right-aligned row with a dead left half.
issues.fix: Put the KPI secondary note on the line below the value, as on the other cards, and clamp labels to one line with ellipsis plus a tooltip. At this width, put Clear filters and Refresh on the bucket row (Auto / Hourly / Daily) to remove the empty row.

issues.element: The search placeholder is clipped mid-word ('Model or request referenc')
issues.fix: Shorten the placeholder to 'Model or request ID' at narrow widths, or give the search box a min-width that fits the full placeholder

issues.element: Row 'Details' buttons and 'Previous' / 'Next' are about 40px tall with larger text, while toolbar buttons (Clear filters, Refresh, Apply) are about 30px. Two button sizes appear on one desktop page.
issues.fix: Use the toolbar's compact button size for row actions and pagination on desktop, and keep 44px only under pointer:coarse

issues.element: Pagination says 'Page 1' with no total while the header says '128 retained events'
issues.fix: Show 'Page 1 of N' or '1–3 of 128' next to Previous/Next

issues.element: The 'Reference: current configured model rates…' note box stops at about 85% width (about 55% at 3440), so its right edge doesn't line up with the toolbar and the Model Rates panel
issues.fix: Remove the max-width on the note container so it spans the content column like every other panel (keep a max line length on the text inside if needed)

issues.element: The time-range pills (Last hour…Last 30 days), the bucket pills (Auto / Hourly / Daily) and 'Current bucket: hour' stay fully active on a page that says 'These are not historical rates'. They look clickable but do nothing here.
issues.fix: On Model Rates, disable the time-range and bucket groups with a tooltip ('Rates are current, not time-based'), or hide them and keep only the provider and model filters

issues.element: Per-row detail access is a '▸ Rate details' disclosure link, while Requests uses a bordered 'Details' button for the same kind of action. The 'Rate details' column header repeats the link text, and at 2293/3440 the link touches the Cache write value.
issues.fix: Use one row-detail affordance on both tables (the same button style). Give the column a blank or short header, and add right padding between Cache write and the action column.

issues.element: The 'No retained events' message says 'Choose a longer range to look further back' but offers no control to do so. The user has to find 'Last 7 days' in the pill group above.
issues.fix: Add an inline secondary button, e.g. 'Show last 7 days', that selects the next longer range

issues.element: 'Clear filters' is enabled although no filter is set, so it suggests filters are causing the empty result
issues.fix: Disable it at defaults. When filters are active in the empty state, say so in the message ('2 filters active — Clear filters').

issues.element: 'View data table' disclosures are offered under both charts that show 'No measured values in this interval.', so the affordance opens nothing useful
issues.fix: Hide or disable 'View data table' when the series has no measured values

issues.element: The TTFT chart and both footnotes keep the hover instruction, and the 'View data table' disclosures are about 18px tall on a touch layout
issues.fix: Use coarse-pointer copy ('Tap a time…') and 44px disclosure hit areas

issues.element: Three reload affordances are visible at once: the header refresh icon, the toolbar 'Refresh' and the white 'Retry' button in the error card. Retry is about 40px tall versus 30px toolbar buttons.
issues.fix: Disable the toolbar Refresh (or hide it) while the error card owns Retry, and size Retry to the toolbar button height on desktop

issues.element: The loading state is a single 'Loading analytics…' text strip. When data arrives, the KPI grid and chart appear below and the page shifts, and there is no spinner or skeleton.
issues.fix: Render skeleton KPI cards and a skeleton chart frame at their final sizes, so the layout matches the loaded page and gives a visible progress cue

issues.element: Refresh is correctly dimmed while loading, but 'Apply', 'Clear filters', and the view/time/bucket pills remain fully enabled, so the user can't tell whether changing them mid-load is allowed
issues.fix: Either keep them enabled and show that a change restarts the load, or dim them alongside Refresh so they match

regressions: overview/tokens at 1366x768: the toolbar 'Refresh' button now wraps alone onto a third toolbar row, left-aligned under the time-range pills, while 'Clear filters' stays at the right. In r11 at 1366, Refresh sat in-row with Apply/Clear filters. The extra row also pushes the trend chart's footer below the fold.
reference_gaps: Search needs an explicit 'Apply' button, and that button is the brightest control on the toolbar. The reference uses a full-width search row that filters without a separate submit button.

The filter dropdowns are native browser selects with OS chevrons. The reference uses styled dropdown triggers that match the pill height and radius, and Prox's selects don't match its segmented pills in radius or padding.

The reference toolbar shows an auto-refresh status chip next to Refresh ('(6s)' with a dot). Prox's Refresh has no live/last-updated indicator beside it (the 'Updated' time sits in the page header instead).
In the reference, 'Clear all' and 'Refresh' stay pinned at the right of the time-range row at every width. Prox's cluster breaks apart at 1366 and moves to its own row at 1024.
The reference has no separate bordered utility box above the toolbar. Prox's header icon group duplicates Refresh and uses a different control size and radius from the toolbar.
